system.description:
You walk between the living and the spirit, the present and the ancestral.

  • Where Druids tend the natural world, Shamans bargain with what lies beneath it.
  • The spirit-talkers of Komodo Isle's clans and of the Red Waste and Treaty Hold orc clans walk this way, outside the Natural Order.
  • Reshapes: Wild Shape (you spend its uses to call a spirit).
  • Ancestor's Call: as your action, spend a use of Wild Shape to call an ancestor spirit within 30ft for 1 minute.
    • It has AC 12 + your Wisdom modifier, HP three times your Druid level (minimum 10), your saves and a flying speed of 30ft.
    • It acts right after you and obeys you freely.
    • Its attack is a magical melee attack, reach 5ft: Base to Hit + your Wisdom modifier, for 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier force damage.
    • It can't be healed.
    • It is a spirit, not undead, and can't be Turned; it is a class companion, not a spell-made attacker.
    • You can have one at a time, and you can call it while in Wild Shape.
    • It goes at 0 HP, after 1 minute, when you call another, or if you are Incapacitated.
    • 9th level: its attack deals 2d8 + your Wisdom modifier, and allies within 10ft of it have Advantage on saves against fear.
  • Spirit Sight: Advantage on checks to perceive, speak with or identify spirits, ancestors and natural extraplanar beings. During a long rest you may ask the spirits one yes or no question about the area or a creature nearby; the answer comes as an impression.
